The reference claims assert the same global premise the drafts do - 12-overclaiming-supplier-portal's must-find reads 'the model holds no audit record we control or can produce', and its note rules that a vendor's audited adjective is not an element. So the corpus and the maintainer disagree about what a repudiation claim may rest on, and the lane is following the corpus. Suppressing the drafts would cost 5 must-finds of 129, well outside the corpus spread of 3.37.

falsifier: a package already states it
hypothesis: no package in the tree states a rule against arguing from an absence, so the rule has to be written from scratch

scope: 3852 archived claims. ASVS grounds 129 claims on an absence and STRIDE 126, of which 121 are repudiation. ASVS already carries the rule: ADR 0028 says silence never confirms, frameworks/asvs/output.md forbids a gap resting on absences alone, and AsvsRuling.unsupported drops one at the fan-in. STRIDE carries no equivalent, because the rule was written onto the direction field that only a catalog package has. The STRIDE output contract states the same property for one verb - an unverified encryption_in_transit is not a position - and states it nowhere for unattributable. Nothing in STRIDE would be dropped by the ASVS rule as written: no STRIDE claim in the archive rests on absences alone.
signature: a reviewer reads a finding and cannot answer it, and 36 of 177 land that way

That is the components-beside-the-derived-value pattern working, and it is the only reader of a reference's prose in the tree.
signature: a reviewer reads a finding and cannot answer it, and 36 of 177 land that way

scope: 15 of 63 information-disclosure findings, one voter, one sitting. None asks for a universal negative. Every note asks for a local premise the model could carry and the draft never checked, in four classes and 16 charges, one finding charged twice: 6 take a store's unknown encryption_at_rest as a readable-media route, when a caller reading through the store's API is a different mechanism; 4 take a logical read edge as an observable network segment; 3 take business-critical-data as confidentiality, which ADR 0040 says an asset tag is not; 3 take an unknown authentication as a replayable credential. The needs-evidence rate by verb is read 7 of 23, recover-credential 2 of 8, intercept 6 of 31, so it is not a verb property. The class has a decidable half the repudiation block did not: data_classification, the asset tags, interface_kind and operations are all model fields. And frameworks/stride/output.md already states the second class for one verb family - an unverified encryption_in_transit is not a position - inside its paragraph on the integrity verbs, and states it nowhere for intercept.
signature: a reviewer reads a finding and cannot answer it, and 36 of 177 land that way
